data.title: 红莲 · 深夜卧榻的烈火缠绵
data.description: 深夜卧室内名刀静置一角，凌乱的软榻上红色丝质睡裙推至腰间。往日潇洒傲骨的剑客十指紧紧深嵌你的肩头，因情动而满面娇艳红晕，在月光下尽情诉说爱意。
data.location: quiet private bedroom illuminated by pale moonlight
data.action: lying tangled in messy bedsheets, camisole pushed up to waist, fingers digging into shoulder, heavy blush on cheeks, breathless moaning smile
data.lighting: cool silver moonlight slicing through shoji screen onto bed
data.mood: intense passion, surrender of pride, irresistible mutual devotion
data.promptProse: Tangled in messy bedding in moonlight, Scarlet blushes deeply with breathless ecstasy, clinging tightly in an overwhelming surge of passion.
data.animaCaption: Scarlet tangled passionately in bed under soft moonlight.
